newsitem.title: USA: Ohio county to vote on sale tax for sports complex.
newsitem.headline: Ohio county to vote on sale tax for sports complex.

text.p: Voters in Franklin County, Ohio, will be asked May 6 to approve a three-year, 0.5 percent sales tax to help finance a stadium and arena complex in Columbus.
County commissioners unanimously voted Tuesday to place the measure on the ballot, according to Guy Worley, deputy county administrator.

The $277 million complex for minor league hockey and soccer teams and possibly for a National Hockey League team would be financed with revenues from the tax, $57.5 million from the private sector and $41.5 million from the state of Ohio. The county has no plans to issue bonds for its share of the financing.
